summary: The AI Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains data infrastructure for AI applications, ensuring high-quality, scalable datasets for training and inference.
responsibilities: Build and maintain AI data pipelines for structured and unstructured data
Collaborate with AI teams to define data requirements
Integrate multiple data sources and ensure consistency
Optimize storage and retrieval of large-scale AI datasets
Implement monitoring, versioning, and lineage for AI data

education: 3–7 years of experience in AI-focused data engineering

skills_required.name: Knowledge of big data frameworks (Spark, Hadoop)
Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS Sagemaker, Azure ML, GCP AI Platform)
Understanding of ML lifecycle and data preparation
